cap: Prostatitis has four patterns. Acute bacterial prostatitis brings fever and a boggy, very tender gland, usually from Escherichia coli, and vigorous massage is avoided because it can push bacteria into the blood. Chronic bacterial prostatitis recurs because the gland hides organisms from all but lipid-soluble antibiotics. Chronic pelvic pain syndrome, with negative cultures, is the most common type and does not respond to antibiotics.
